verdict_reason: Workflow is functionally correct (fork/dependabot guards, OIDC role, tag sanitisation all match the estate standard) but duplicates the shared reusable workflow inline and has already drifted by pinning docker/build-push-action to v4.0.0.

todos.issue: Inlines a full 78-line copy of the shared reusable workflow DEFRA/trade-imports-animals-workspace/.github/workflows/publish-branch.yml@main, which all 8 sibling repos call with a 6-line caller; the copy will silently drift from the estate (it already has, see the action pin) and fixes to the shared workflow will not reach this repo.
todos.fix: Replace the job body with 'uses: DEFRA/trade-imports-animals-workspace/.github/workflows/publish-branch.yml@main' plus 'with: image-name: trade-imports-address-book' and 'secrets: inherit', matching trade-imports-dynamics-gateway/.github/workflows/publish-branch.yml.

todos.issue: docker/build-push-action is pinned to SHA 3b5e8027fcad23fda98b2e3ac259d8d67585f671, which resolves to tag v4.0.0 (Feb 2023, action runtime 'node16') - three majors behind the @v7 used by the shared workspace workflow and every other repo; node16 action runtimes are deprecated and force-migrated by GitHub with warnings, and the pin carries no version comment so nobody can tell what it is.
todos.fix: Use the shared reusable workflow (which is on @v7), or if the inline copy stays, repin to the v7 release SHA with a trailing '# v7.x.x' comment.
